test_decoration_does_not_call_the_functi.title: test_decoration_does_not_call_the_function_or_print
test_decoration_does_not_call_the_functi.code:
def test_decoration_does_not_call_the_function_or_print(capsys):
    calls = []
    def filling():
        calls.append("called")
    decorated = sandwich(filling)
    assert callable(decorated)
    assert calls == []
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == ""

test_propagates_the_original_exception.title: test_propagates_the_original_exception
test_propagates_the_original_exception.code:
def test_propagates_the_original_exception(capsys):
    error = ValueError("bad filling")
    calls = []
    @sandwich
    def reject(value):
        calls.append(value)
        raise error
    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as caught:
        reject("spoiled")
    assert caught.value is error
    assert calls == ["spoiled"]
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.startswith(UPPER_SLICE + "\n")
